Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of BAC.
Our gross margin expanded by 22 basis points to 71.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2022.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $3.94 per share.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $32.8 billion this quarter, representing 13% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 22 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
